question: Which of the following countries never hosted the Paralympic games ?
solution:
The correct answer is__** India.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• **India has never hosted the Paralympic games.**
 
• The Paralympic Games are an international multi-sport event **for athletes with disabilities.**
 
• It is held** every four years**, following the Olympic games. 
 
• The** first Paralympic games **were held in** Rome, Italy in 1960.**
 
• Since then, it has grown to become the world's** third-largest sporting event**, after the Olympic games and the FIFA World Cup.
 
• The Paralympic games feature a wide range of sports, including **athletics, swimming, wheelchair basketball, and sitting volleyball, among others.​**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Israel** hosted the Paralympic Games in **Tel Aviv in 1968,** which is the only time the games have been held in the Middle East.
 
• **Japan** hosted the Paralympic Games in **1964 in Tokyo**, and again in the **Summer Paralympics 2020 (held in 2021 due to the COVID-19 pandemic).**
 
• **South Korea** hosted the Paralympic Games in** Seoul in 1988 **and again in the **Winter Paralympics 2018 in PyeongChang.**
